findings.summary: Body's central claims are false or unsupported: definitions() was already sorted on base so output is unchanged, the speed claim has no measurement (and add_defaults gets slower), and the only real effect (select/negate all ordering) goes unmentioned
PR body reads as machine-written, which AI_POLICY.md says gets PRs closed
New test passes on base so proves nothing, and the path that did change (select/negate all order) is untested
Test has conversation residue: stale HashMap comment and a dead build() call
Title and commit message don't match the repo's area: message style and hide the HashMap to BTreeMap swap

why: Finding 1 says the claimed nondeterminism doesn't exist on base and the speedup is unmeasured, so the PR has no demonstrated need, which matches the maintainer's status-quo reason.
